prompt:
Create ONE polished native editable static SVG containing TWO proposed future Last Hearth umber long-eared bat portraits, NORMAL LEFT and ASCENDED RIGHT. This is a visual-development family, not accepted canon, an established game slot or new gameplay powers. Exact canvas/viewBox 1440x512. Two 720x512 cells, named top-level groups bat-normal transform="translate(0 0)" and bat-ascended transform="translate(720 0)". Every painted shape belongs to one cell group, each beginning with a full local 720x512 #172928 background rectangle. Keep the complete creature and minimal support inside local x=40..680,y=36..476. No text, labels, frame, stats, logos, watermark or UI.
SAME NATURAL BAT IDENTITY: compact warm umber fur body, short fitted muzzle, long soft-edged ears with broad connected roots, small inset alert dark eyes, warm ivory chest plane and thin warm brown membranes. Two wing-bearing FORELIMBS and TWO hindlegs only. The wings ARE the arms: never add a separate pair of arms/hands in front of the wings. Shoulder-to-upper-arm-to-elbow-to-wrist transitions stay physically joined; elongated fingers fan beneath each continuous membrane, with one small free thumb claw at its wrist. Wing roots blend into the fur shoulders and their lower membranes attach along the flank toward the ankle. No detached fingers, floating membrane triangles, exposed joint caps, holes at the shoulder or dangling unconnected wing panels. A small joined tail membrane between hindlegs may be shown; do not add a long decorative tail.
NORMAL: diagonal hanging/resting bat beneath a short irregular rock lip. The two hindfeet visibly hook the underside at unequal heights and support the animal's weight. Body hangs down-left, head turns slightly toward viewer. Unequal folded membranes follow the body's diagonal; near wing is partly folded around the flank with its wrist/thumb readable, far wing appears as a quieter narrow folded plane. Keep the fur head and chest connected and the hanging feet obvious; this must read as a real resting bat rather than a hooded cloak or upside-down imp. No mirror symmetry.
ASCENDED: recognizably the same bat in a distinct launch from a different minimal rock lip near lower-left. One hindfoot finishes pushing while the other releases and tucks; body reaches diagonally up-right. Near wing opens broadly up-left with a visible bent elbow and continuous wrist/finger fan; far wing opens lower and farther right. Unequal wing angles, clear spaces beside the head and a stronger upward action create the upgraded silhouette. Do not merely spread two identical triangles behind the normal pose. Keep all wingtips, ears, feet and supporting rock inside the safe area.
STYLE: Hearth expressive engraved fantasy, connected organic curves and three broad modeled values before sparse form-following cuts. Fur umber #786457, lighter fur #b9aa8f, shadow #463d35; membranes warm brown #675149 with restrained #a88a78 planes; ivory upper-left light #dfd4b4. Quiet dark forest field. Matte fur and thin taut membrane must feel different. Fingers are supporting structure, not a dense striped texture. Economical roughly 45-70 filled paths per scene is a soft target, without sacrificing anatomy. Recognition must survive 160x112,80x56,64x45. Small fitted eyes, no mascot goggles. No demon horns, feathers, armor, clothing, jewelry, all-gold edging, excessive fur hatching, glowing powers, scenery or decorative anatomy.
OUTPUT: true static native vector paths/simple shapes, explicit flat paints only. No raster/image elements, scripts, external resources, animation, use references, defs, gradients, masks or filters. Named scenes extract independently in local coordinates without cross-cell debris.
